verses.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.pt: Jesus chamou a si os seus doze discípulos, e deu-lhes poder sobre os espíritos imundos, para os expulsarem, e curarem toda enfermidade e toda doença.
verses.en_web: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.
verses.en_bbe: And he got together his twelve disciples and gave them the power of driving out unclean spirits, and of making well all sorts of disease and pain.

verses.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.pt: E os nomes dos doze apóstolos são estes: o primeiro, Simão, chamado Pedro, e seu irmão André; Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João;
verses.en_web: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;
verses.en_bbe: Now the names of the twelve are these: The first, Simon, who is named Peter, and Andrew, his brother; James, the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother;

verses.en: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.pt: Filipe e Bartolomeu; Tomé, e Mateus o publicano; Tiago, filho de Alfeu; e Lebeu, por sobrenome Tadeu;
verses.en_web: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;
verses.en_bbe: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew, the tax-farmer; James, the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;

verses.en: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.pt: Simão o zeloso, e Judas Iscariotes, o mesmo que o traiu.
verses.en_web: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.en_bbe: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, who was false to him.

verses.en: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.pt: Jesus enviou esses doze, e lhes mandou, dizendo: Não ireis pelo caminho dos gentios, nem entrareis em cidade de samaritanos.
verses.en_web: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
verses.en_bbe: These twelve Jesus sent out and gave them orders, saying, Do not go among the Gentiles, or into any town of Samaria,

verses.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.pt: Em vez disso, ide às ovelhas perdidas da casa de Israel.
verses.en_web: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: But go to the wandering sheep of the house of Israel,

verses.en: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.pt: E quando fordes, proclamai, dizendo: ‘Perto está o Reino dos céus’.
verses.en_web: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’
verses.en_bbe: And, on your way, say, The kingdom of heaven is near.

verses.en: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.pt: Curai os doentes, limpai os leprosos, ressuscitai os mortos, expulsai os demônios; recebestes de graça, dai de graça.
verses.en_web: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.
verses.en_bbe: Make well those who are ill, give life to the dead, make lepers clean, send evil spirits out of men; freely it has been given to you, freely give.

verses.en: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.pt: Não tomeis convosco ouro, nem prata, nem cobre em vossos cintos;
verses.en_web: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.
verses.en_bbe: Take no gold or silver or copper in your pockets;

verses.en: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.pt: nem bolsas para o caminho, nem duas túnicas, nem sandálias, nem bordão; pois o trabalhador é digno de seu alimento.
verses.en_web: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.
verses.en_bbe: Take no bag for your journey and do not take two coats or shoes or a stick: for the workman has a right to his food.

verses.en: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.pt: E em qualquer cidade ou aldeia que entrardes, informai-vos de quem nela seja digno, e ficai ali até que saiais.
verses.en_web: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.
verses.en_bbe: And into whatever town or small place you go, make search there for someone who is respected, and make his house your resting-place till you go away.

verses.en: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.pt: E quando entrardes na casa, saudai-a.
verses.en_web: As you enter into the household, greet it.
verses.en_bbe: And when you go in, say, May peace be on this house.

verses.en: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.pt: Se a casa for digna, venha sobre ela a vossa paz; mas se ela não for digna, volte para vós a vossa paz.
verses.en_web: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.en_bbe: And if the house is good enough, let your peace come on it: but if not, let your peace come back to you.

verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.pt: E quem quer que não vos receber, nem ouvir vossas palavras, quando sairdes daquela casa ou cidade, sacudi o pó de vossos pés.
verses.en_web: Whoever doesn’t receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.
verses.en_bbe: And whoever will not take you in, or give ear to your words, when you go out from that house or that town, put off its dust from your feet.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.pt: Em verdade vos digo que no dia do julgamento mais tolerável será para a região de Sodoma e Gomorra do que para aquela cidade.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, It will be better for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of God's judging than for that town.

verses.en: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.pt: Eis que eu vos envio como ovelhas em meio de lobos; portanto, sede prudentes como as serpentes e inofensivos como pombas.
verses.en_web: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.en_bbe: See, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Be then as wise as snakes, and as gentle as doves.

verses.en: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.pt: Porém tende cuidado com as pessoas; porque vos entregarão em tribunais, e vos açoitarão em suas sinagogas;
verses.en_web: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.
verses.en_bbe: But be on the watch against men: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins, and in their Synagogues they will give you blows;

verses.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.pt: E até perante governadores e reis sereis levados por causa de mim, para que haja testemunho a eles e aos gentios.
verses.en_web: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
verses.en_bbe: And you will come before rulers and kings because of me, for a witness to them and to the Gentiles.

verses.en: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.pt: Mas quando vos entregarem, não estejais ansiosos de como ou que falareis; porque naquela mesma hora vos será dado o que deveis falar.
verses.en_web: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.
verses.en_bbe: But when you are given up into their hands, do not be troubled about what to say or how to say it: for in that hour what you are to say will be given to you;

verses.en: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.pt: Porque não sois vós os que falais, mas sim o Espírito do vosso Pai que fala em vós.
verses.en_web: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.
verses.en_bbe: Because it is not you who say the words, but the Spirit of your Father in you.

verses.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.pt: E irmão entregará irmão à morte, e pai ao filho; e filhos se levantarão contra os pais, e os matarão.
verses.en_web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child: and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.

verses.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.pt: E sereis odiados por todos por causa de meu nome; mas aquele que perseverar até o fim, esse será salvo.
verses.en_web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
verses.en_bbe: And you will be hated by all men because of my name: but he who is strong to the end will have salvation.

verses.en: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.pt: Quando, então, vos perseguirem nesta cidade, fugi para outra; porque em verdade vos digo que não acabareis de percorrer as cidades de Israel, até que venha o Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.
verses.en_bbe: But when they are cruel to you in one town, go in flight to another: for truly, I say to you, You will not have gone through the towns of Israel before the Son of man comes.

verses.en: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.pt: O discípulo não é superior ao mestre, nem o servo superior ao seu senhor.
verses.en_web: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.
verses.en_bbe: A disciple is not greater than his master, or a servant than his lord.

verses.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.pt: Seja suficiente ao discípulo ser como o seu mestre, e ao servo como o seu senhor; se ao chefe da casa chamaram de Belzebu, quanto mais aos membros de sua casa!
verses.en_web: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!
verses.en_bbe: It is enough for the disciple that he may be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have given the name Beelzebub to the master of the house, how much more to those of his house!

verses.en: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.pt: Portanto, não os temais; porque nada há encoberto que não se revelará, nada oculto que não se saberá.
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed; and hidden that will not be known.
verses.en_bbe: Have, then, no fear of them: because nothing is covered which will not come to light, or secret which will not be made clear.

verses.en: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.pt: O que eu vos digo em trevas, dizei na luz; e o que ouvis ao ouvido, proclamai sobre os telhados.
verses.en_web: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.
verses.en_bbe: What I say to you in the dark, say in the light: and what comes to your ear secretly, say publicly from the house-tops.

verses.en: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.pt: E não temais os que matam o corpo, mas não podem matar a alma; temei mais aquele que pode destruir tanto a alma como o corpo no inferno.
verses.en_web: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.
verses.en_bbe: And have no fear of those who put to death the body, but are not able to put to death the soul. But have fear of him who has power to give soul and body to destruction in hell.

verses.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.pt: Não se vendem dois pardais por uma pequena moeda? Mas nem um deles cairá em terra contra a vontade de vosso Pai.
verses.en_web: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls on the ground apart from your Father’s will,
verses.en_bbe: Are not sparrows two a farthing? and not one of them comes to an end without your Father:

verses.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.pt: E até os cabelos de vossas cabeças estão todos contados.
verses.en_web: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.en_bbe: But the hairs of your head are all numbered.

verses.en: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.pt: Assim, não tenhais medo; mais valeis vós que muitos pardais.
verses.en_web: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.en_bbe: Then have no fear; you are of more value than a flock of sparrows.

verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.pt: Portanto, todo aquele que me der reconhecimento diante das pessoas, também eu o reconhecerei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
verses.en_web: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, him I will also confess before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: To everyone, then, who gives witness to me before men, I will give witness before my Father in heaven.

verses.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.pt: Porém qualquer um que me negar diante das pessoas, também eu o negarei diante de meu Pai, que está nos céus.
verses.en_web: But whoever denies me before men, him I will also deny before my Father who is in heaven.
verses.en_bbe: But if anyone says before men that he has no knowledge of me, I will say that I have no knowledge of him before my Father in heaven.

verses.en: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.pt: Não penseis que vim trazer paz à terra. Não vim trazer paz, mas sim espada.
verses.en_web: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
verses.en_bbe: Do not have the thought that I have come to send peace on the earth; I came not to send peace but a sword.

verses.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.pt: Porque eu vim pôr em discórdia ‘o homem contra seu pai, a filha contra sua mãe, e a nora contra sua sogra.
verses.en_web: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.
verses.en_bbe: For I have come to put a man against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law:

verses.en: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.pt: E os inimigos do homem serão os de sua própria casa’. Miqueias 7:6
verses.en_web: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.
verses.en_bbe: And a man will be hated by those of his house.

verses.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.pt: Quem ama pai ou mãe mais que a mim não é digno de mim; e quem ama filho ou filha mais que a mim não é digno de mim;
verses.en_web: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
verses.en_bbe: He who has more love for his father or mother than for me is not good enough for me; he who has more love for son or daughter than for me is not good enough for me.

verses.en: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.pt: E quem não toma sua cruz e segue após mim não é digno de mim.
verses.en_web: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me, isn’t worthy of me.
verses.en_bbe: And he who does not take his cross and come after me is not good enough for me.

verses.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.pt: Quem achar sua vida a perderá; e quem, por causa de mim, perder sua vida, a achará.
verses.en_web: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.
verses.en_bbe: He who has the desire to keep his life will have it taken from him, and he who gives up his life because of me will have it given back to him.

verses.en: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.pt: Quem vos recebe, recebe a mim; e quem me recebe, recebe aquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives honour to you gives honour to me; and he who gives honour to me gives honour to him who sent me.

verses.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.pt: Quem recebe um profeta por reconhecê-lo como profeta receberá recompensa de profeta; e quem recebe um justo por reconhecê-lo como justo receberá recompensa de justo.
verses.en_web: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.en_bbe: He who gives honour to a prophet, in the name of a prophet, will be given a prophet's reward; and he who gives honour to an upright man, in the name of an upright man, will be given an upright man's reward.

verses.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.pt: E qualquer um que der ainda que somente um copo de água fria a um destes pequenos por reconhecê-lo como discípulo, em verdade vos digo que de maneira nenhuma perderá sua recompensa.
verses.en_web: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you he will in no way lose his reward.”
verses.en_bbe: And whoever gives to one of these little ones a cup of cold water only, in the name of a disciple, truly I say to you, he will not go without his reward.
